messages:
tara: launching blue/green for router-proxy v1.8.0 in the 90m change window (2026-03-22T04:00Z->2026-03-22T05:30Z). plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. LB flip at edge-proxy layer. session-affinity must be preserved. runbook: https://runbook.internal/router-proxy-bluegreen

deploy-bot: PRECHECK OK. starting shift: applying 5%.

nate: note: cookie TTL default=8m; recommend extend to 12m for safe stickiness during shift. ops-oncall can you toggle?

ops-oncall: toggled cookie-ttl to 12m. Also enabled gradual-weight-change on LB. watching metrics: backend-p95, p99, 5xx, reconnections.

ci-bot: smoke tests triggered -> login/auth, websocket reconnect, batch requests. initial smoke passed 5/6 (one flake on websocket in us-east).

deploy-bot: ramp to 25% in 10m.

ops-oncall: observing slight p99 jitter at 25% (peak ~540ms for 30s), error-rate stable <0.4%. hold for warmup metric: kv_cache_ready > 92% for 3m. current 89%. holding.

tara: hold on ramp until kv ready. if kv warmup takes >8m we'll abort to avoid user impact.

deploy-bot: warmup satisfied -> kv_cache_ready=95%. ramping to 60%.

nate: after 60% saw small retry increase from downstream service (svc-b) caused by backoff config. applying temporary max_retries=2 to prevent fanout. command: `kubectl patch cm router-proxy-config -p '{"data":{"max_retries":"2"}}'`

ops-oncall: monitoring: p95=180ms, p99=360ms, 5xx=0.2%, connection-retries normalized. rollback criteria: p95>240ms for 3min OR 5xx>2% sustained 2m OR reconnect rate >1% -> execute rollback to v1.7.9.

deploy-bot: final ramp -> 100% applied. performing post-deploy checks.

ci-bot: full smoke and quick-e2e passed.

release-notes-bot: Published notes -> https://docs.internal/releases/router-proxy-v1.8.0 (mentions cookie-ttl, kv warmup, retry cap tweak).

tara: pin traffic and update /traffic/pins to v1.8.0. also create follow-up to revert temp retry change in 24h if stable. thanks team. :party:

ops-oncall: leaving 30m watch. all good so far.
